Virginia Beach, VA · Road

Beginner friendly

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 15–17 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness.
Check
Look at @tripowercycling the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Sunday Beginner Ride (Tripower Cycling Club) group ride

The club's newest ride, a 20-mile D-group loop for people getting into road riding. Leaves from Conte's on Laskin Road. The main Sunday ride goes 55 miles at 18 to 20 mph from the same spot at 7:30. Saturday loop rides split into A+ through C groups.
